basic_info.description: Charming sun-filled top floor 3 bedroom, 1 bath flat in prestigious Russian Hill. Built in 1908, the full-floor flat features beautiful interiors and offers a private sanctuary in the heart of the city. With spacious rooms, high ceilings and city views, this stylish residence blends period details with modern updates throughout. The living room with period built-ins opens to the large kitchen with views out to the oversized sunny yard. Eat-in kitchen is outfitted with new appliances, a dedicated dining area, and a walkout that leads directly to the yard. Large primary bedroom easily fits a king bed, while the second bedroom features a fireplace and large south-facing windows. A third south-facing bedroom and a bathroom complete the home. In-unit, full-size washer & dryer and bonus garden room that could be configured as a home office. The expansive shared yard on this deep lot has multiple terraced seating areas and mature plants & trees. Building exterior painted last year. Walking distance to entertainment & dining, including Frascati & Swensen's Ice Cream, with Polk Street and North Beach nearby. New Francisco Park, Alice Marble basketball & tennis courts and Ina Coolbrith park offer recreation with stunning water & city views. Walk score of 98.
